@SecondReading.Tested.undecidable_extensions_of_reduction : ∀ {L : Language} [inst : Encodable (Sentence L)]
  (T : Theory L) (P N : Set ℕ),
  Numerical.RecursivelyInseparable P N →
    ∀ (f : ℕ → Sentence L),
      (Computable fun n => Encodable.encode (f n)) →
        (∀ n ∈ P, T ⊢ f n) →
          (∀ n ∈ N, T ⊢ ∼f n) →
            ∀ (U : Theory L),
              T ⊆ U → Entailment.Consistent U → ¬ComputablePred fun w => ∃ φ, Encodable.encode φ = w ∧ U ⊢ φ
'SecondReading.Tested.undecidable_extensions_of_reduction' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
